name: nautiloid
title: New game → Nautiloid escaped (the launch bar)
about: The launch-bar series (3/3 clean, 2026-10-13, series naut): a new game, character creation from the brief, the prologue until the Nautiloid crashes. v2: converted from scenarios/nautiloid.json (same start, goal, caps and brief), dice seeded, difficulty fixed to Balanced.

character.brief: A level-headed half-elf fighter, once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant: protects the weak, keeps promises, distrusts mind magic and anyone who offers easy power.
